left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Infants of healthy mothers  [AND] with uncomplicated pregnancies at term, mothers of any ethnic or social background that can speak, read, and understand Swedish to the extent that they can consent in Swedish

right.raw_text: An additional inclusion criterion for mothers in the CS groups is vaginal pH ≤ 4 at the time of birth

left.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Infants of mothers with pre-eclampsia  [OR] or complicated pregnancies, mothers <18 years  [OR] or >40 years of age, genital herpes simplex, [OR]  genital warts, [OR]  HIV, [OR]  Hepatitis B  [OR] or complications during delivery, infants delivered prior to 37 weeks of gestation
Additional exclusion criteria for mothers in the CS group: Mothers positive to Group B Streptococcus, [OR]  Group A Streptococcus, [OR]  bacterial vaginosis, [OR]  vaginal pH > 4 at the time of birth

right.raw_text: Mothers with fecal samples positive for Salmonella, [OR]  Shigella, [OR]  Campylobacter  [OR] or Yersinia
